questions.statement: I wear a ________ on my head when it is sunny.
questions.context: Learning about clothes and accessories in English class.

A shoe goes on your foot, not on your head.
A sock goes inside your shoe on your foot, so it is never worn on the head.
A glove covers the hand to keep it warm, not the head.
